# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**8:1** They spread their roots to the watercourse; its trunk is open to the living water.

**8:2** And it becomes an eternal source. And in the shoot of its foliage all the beasts of the forest feed.

**8:3** Its trunk is trodden by all who pass on the way, and its branches by all the birds.

**8:4** And all the trees of water rise above it, for in their planting they grow tall.

**8:5** But they send not their root to the watercourse.

**8:6** And the shoot that brings forth the holy seed for the planting of truth is hidden and not esteemed.

**8:7** And the mystery of its seal is not known, and You, O God, You have enclosed its fruit.

**8:8** With the mystery of mighty warriors and spirits of holiness and the whirling flame of fire.

**8:9** And no [...] shall come to the fountain of life, nor shall he drink with the eternal trees.

**8:10** The holy waters shall he not touch, nor bear his fruit with the planting of the clouds.

**8:11** For he sees but does not recognize, and he considers but does not believe in the fountain of life.

**8:12** And I [...] become food for the torrents. But the planting of fruit shall send forth its branches to the [...].

**8:13** And the shoot of the everlasting planting upon all the [...] shall take root.

**8:14** And it shall cover the whole earth with its shade, and its [...] to the clouds.

**8:15** And its roots to the abyss. And all the rivers of Eden [...] shall water the branches.

**8:16** And it shall become [...] a forest of great trees, and the shoot of its planting is upon all the world.

**8:17** Beyond limit and beyond all [...] to Sheol. And the fountain of light shall become an eternal wellspring.

**8:18** That does not fail. In its shining sparks all the sons of [...] shall be ignited.

**8:19** And it shall become a fire that burns all the men of guilt unto destruction.

**8:20** And those who joined my testimony have let themselves be persuaded by the interpreters of error.

**8:21** For the wicked have schemed against me, to exchange Your Torah which You have engraved in my heart.

**8:22** For smooth things to Your people. And they withhold from the thirsty the drink of knowledge.

**8:23** And for their thirst they give them vinegar to drink, to gaze upon their error.

**8:24** To act madly at their feasts and to be caught in their nets.

**8:25** But You, O God, despise every counsel of Belial, and Your plan it is that shall stand.

**8:26** And the purpose of Your heart it is that is established forever.

**8:27** And they, the pretenders, they plan devices of Belial, and they seek You with a double heart.

**8:28** And they are not established in Your truth. A root that produces poison and wormwood is in their thoughts.

**8:29** And in the stubbornness of their heart they spy about and seek You in idols.

**8:30** And the stumbling-block of their iniquity they set before their face.

**8:31** And they come to inquire of You from the mouth of false prophets, seduced by error.

**8:32** And then they speak [...] to Your people with a stammering lip and a strange tongue.

**8:33** To make foolish by deceit all their works. For they have not chosen [...] Your [...]

**8:34** And they have not listened to Your word, for they said of the vision of knowledge: It is not certain.

**8:35** And of the way of Your heart: It is not this.

**8:36** But You, O God, will answer them, to judge them in Your might according to their idols.

**8:37** And according to the multitude of their transgressions, that they may be caught in their own schemes who have turned from Your covenant.

---

*EMET notes: Column 8 continues the planting imagery from Column 7 then transitions to polemic against opponents. The "shoot of the holy seed" (8:6) has messianic overtones (cf. Isaiah 6:13). The fire-and-light imagery (8:17-19) is dual: life-giving light for the elect, destroying fire for the wicked. "Torah engraved in my heart" (8:21) echoes Jeremiah 31:33.*
